title: Totes
body:
## **<center>Totes!</center>**


Tired of cluttered chests and overflowing inventories? Totes introduces a comprehensive, scalable, and intelligent storage system designed to streamline your Minecraft experience. From massive item capacities to wireless management and advanced automation, Totes offers a modern solution for all your storage needs.


## **<center>Key Features</center>**

## Totes:

◦ Massive Capacity: Each Tote starts with a base capacity of 2048 items.

◦ Tiered Upgrades: Enhance your Totes with Copper (2x), Iron (4x), Gold (6x), Diamond (8x), and Netherite (10x) upgrades. Stack up to 4 upgrades for truly colossal storage!

◦ Void Upgrade: Never worry about overflow again! Apply a Void Upgrade to automatically void any excess items when the Tote reaches its maximum capacity.

◦ Lockable: Lock a Tote to a specific item type, ensuring only that item can be stored.

◦ Visual Clarity: See at a glance what's inside, whether it's locked, the quantity, and what upgrades are within!

◦ Portable Inventory: Break and pick up Totes without losing a single item, upgrade, or lock status. They retain all their data, making relocation a breeze.

◦ Automation Ready: Easily pipe items in and out using your favorite logistics mods like Pipez or Mekanism.

## Tote Controller:

◦ Centralized Management: Link multiple Totes to a single Controller, creating a unified storage network.

◦ Intelligent Routing: Input items into the Controller, and it will automatically distribute them, prioritizing Totes that already contain the item, then filling empty Totes.

◦ Wireless Access: Connect your entire Tote network to your automation systems through a single block.

## Tote Linker:

◦ Intuitive Linking: Use the Tote Linker to easily connect Totes to your Controller. Right-click a Controller to set it as the target, then right-click Totes to link them.

◦ Mode Switching: Cycle between "ADD" and "REMOVE" modes by right-clicking the air.

◦ Clear Target: Shift-right-click the air to clear your active Controller target.

◦ X-Ray Vision: Holding the Linker provides an X-Ray highlight, displaying your Totes (Green) and Tote Controller (Blue):

## Plastic:

◦ Crafting material, essential for crafting items in this mod.

◦ Crafted by smelting Dried Kelp in a furnace or blast furnace.



## **<center>Beta</center>**

This is mod is currently in Beta. If there are bugs, or you have suggestions to implement, please leave a comment or submit an issue. I am not an artist, so some items do not look great at the moment. If you would like to contribute any art, please reach out and you will be credited.
